correctness.rationale: For Phi_x=(1-x)id+(x/2)(Tr(.)I-T), 0<=x<=1, scalar/symmetric-traceless/skew-transpose eigenvalues are 1,s=1-3x/2,a=1-x/2. The normalized Choi partial transpose has ranks 3,1,5 eigenvalues (2-5s^k-3a^k)/18, (1+5s^k-3a^k)/9, (2+s^k+3a^k)/18. The third stays positive. Orthogonally invariant Choi states are determined by f=Tr(rho F),g=Tr(rho P), with PPT rectangle 0<=f<=1,0<=g<=1/3; all four corners are orthogonal twirls of explicit product states, so PPT iff separable within this family. Thus exact two EB inequalities hold for every k. Rational x=1/2 checks k1..4 give first EB at k=4, k=2 interval is [(4+sqrt2)/7,1], x=0 never, x>0 eventually. Monotone small-x exponential limit gives x*nEB -> -2 log y, 5y^3+3y=2. Independently reconstructed 30 direct 9x9 Choi matrices/eigenvalues and exact rational critical cases; this finite test is supplementary.
